skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 2 consecutive strikes, dealing 500% ATK DMG. Each strike has a 50% chance to add 1 stack of [Specialized Burn] to the target. [Specialized Burn]: Deals 300% ATK as DoT DMG. After any character acts, transfers the effect to a random target and disappears after being transferred 3 times.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 2 consecutive strikes, dealing 700% ATK DMG. Each strike has an 80% chance to add 1 stack of [Specialized Burn] to the target. [Specialized Burn]: Deals 400% ATK as DoT DMG. After any character acts, transfers the effect to a random target and disappears after being transferred 3 times.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. After any character acts, [Detonate] activates, converting 400% of a single [Specialized Burn] DMG into [Detonation] DMG. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Reduces all types of non-critical DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. After any character acts, [Detonate] activates, converting 450% of a single [Specialized Burn] DMG into [Detonation] DMG. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Reduces all types of non-critical DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. After any character acts, [Detonate] activates, converting 500% of a single [Specialized Burn] DMG into [Detonation] DMG. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Reduces all types of non-critical DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: After any character acts, absorbs 40% of [Detonation] DMG and deals [True DMG] to the 3 enemies with the lowest HP. [True DMG]: Not affected by DMG Rate or DMG Free, and deals Direct DMG without [DMG Sharing] or [Evasion].

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: After any character acts, absorbs 40% of [Detonation] DMG and deals [True DMG] to the entire enemy team. [True DMG]: Not affected by DMG Rate or DMG Free, and deals Direct DMG without [DMG Sharing] or [Evasion].
